items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stan said, “why don’t you come out and play trombone,” so we played, you know several weeks together.

ctx.x: So when you got back to New York and you went with Chubby Jackson, then what happened?

Well, Chubby’s band petered out after a while. I went to work with, for a while then with Stan Getz I think, Bobby Brookmeyer was supposed to come in and he couldn’t make it, he was tied up somewhere, he was with someone, so Stan said, “why don’t you come out and play trombone,” so we played, you know several weeks together. Bill Crow was in the band, it was great but I knew I was in fast company… and Stan, you know I kept bringing new music in I’d hear… you know Mulligan had come out with the piano-less band by…
